movement_profile.footwork: Step on every first beat for one-step; slow-slow-quick-quick for Nilkku

signature_moves.description: A slow-slow-quick-quick rhythm where the first quick step takes minimal weight, creating a limping gait.
signature_moves.name: Nilkku

music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Strong bass on the first beat (hump), second beat (pa)
music_profile.sound_description: A steady, driving 2/4 beat characterized by a prominent tuba-like bass pulse on the downbeat, creating a bouncing, energetic feel.

basic_steps: Maintain a consistent vertical bounce with the bass
teaching.formation: Closed or open position, moving in the direction of dance
teaching.level_notes: Beginner: focus on the bounce; Intermediate: Nilkku limping gait
